rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１０Your answer...＝＠００１＿０１１Heh. No need to ask, is there?￥...I'm counting on you.
＊Riko＊＠０８９＿０２３Heh, as if you'd turn me down!＝＠０８９＿０２４I chose you, so we're sure￥to be fine!
＊Riko＊＠０８９＿０２５I have faith in your abilities,￥after all!
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Riko Depart　－
＊Riko＊＠０８９＿０２６I'm so happy!＝＠０８９＿０２７Standing here as one who￥qualified is part of it, but￥more than anything...＝＠０８９＿０２８I'm happiest that I get to go￥with you!!
＊Riko＊＠０８９＿０２６I'm so happy!＝＠０８９＿０２７Standing here as one who￥qualified is part of it, but￥more than anything...＝＠０８９＿０２９I'm happiest that I got to￥choose you!!
